name: Rice, long duration (Samba / Thaladi / Pishanam)
source: Seasons: TN Agri Dept Crop Production Guide (CPG) Rice: Samba Aug, Thaladi Sep-Oct (Thanjavur); Samba Aug-Sep (Madurai); Pishanam Sep-Oct (Tirunelveli). Water: TNAU eagri AGRO103 lec07, rice 1100-1250 mm (upper end for long duration)
wind_source: Approximate. Lodging-prone tall / heavy-headed crops rated low; TN cyclone damage assessments (Thane 2011, Gaja 2018, Nivar 2020) list banana, sugarcane, paddy near harvest and maize among the worst hit; short pulses and groundnut rated high.

storage.source: Approximate: dried paddy keeps 6-12 months at safe moisture; not yet sourced

name: Kodo millet (varagu)
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Small Millets, Masi / Adi / Purattasi pattams; CO 3 120 days, TNAU 86 105-110 days; rain-fed yield 1500-3200 kg/ha. Roots: shallow, fibrous root system (Paspalum scrobiculatum, Wikipedia; 'Scientific cultivation practices of Kodo millet'); was 'deep' (unsourced) until RESEARCH_LOG I-28. Drought: a TN seedling-stage PEG screen ranked kodo CO 3 least tolerant of the small millets tested (IJPSS). Water: approximate, millets 300-600 mm; 350 mm kept (longest small-millet season)
wind_source: Approximate. Lodging-prone tall / heavy-headed crops rated low; TN cyclone damage assessments (Thane 2011, Gaja 2018, Nivar 2020) list banana, sugarcane, paddy near harvest and maize among the worst hit; short pulses and groundnut rated high.

name: Cowpea
source: Seasons and duration: TN CPG Cowpea, Adipattam Jun-Aug, Purattasi Sep-Nov, Margazhi-Thai Dec-Feb; Co(CP) 7 70-75 days, VBN 3 75-80 days; 'sensitive to waterlogging, though less than other legumes' (CPG) -> flood low. Heat/drought: long taproot and leaf/stomatal control give strong drought tolerance (FAO cowpea compendium); roots measured ~2.4 m at 8 weeks but most water comes from the top ~30 cm (Purdue AFCM; UC SAREP), so root_depth kept at medium (conservative). Checked in RESEARCH_LOG I-34
